description_en: Creates a Simple Application Server key pair
description_zh: 创建轻量应用服务器密钥对
kebab_example: aliyun swas-open create-key-pair --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --biz-key-pair-name KeyPairName --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateKeyPair

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Simple Application Server instance.
Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html to view the list of supported Alibaba Cloud regions
parameters.help_zh:
指定的轻量数据库实例所属的地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html查看支持的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique value from your client for this parameter. The token can contain only ASCII characters and must be no more than 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多详情，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The name of the key pair. The name must be 2 to 64 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character and cannot start with http\:// or https\://. The name can contain digits, colons (:), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 密钥对名称。长度为2~64个英文或中文字符。必须以大小写字母或中文开头，不能以http://或https://开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者短划线（-）
parameters.name: key_pair_name

KeyPairName.description_en: The name of the key pair. The name must be 2 to 64 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character and cannot start with http\:// or https\://. The name can contain digits, colons (:), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
KeyPairName.description_zh: 密钥对名称。长度为2~64个英文或中文字符。必须以大小写字母或中文开头，不能以http://或https://开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者短划线（-）

PrivateKeyBody.description_en: The private key of the key pair. The private key is PEM-encoded in the PKCS#8 format
PrivateKeyBody.description_zh: 密钥对的私钥。PEM编码的PKCS#8格式的私钥部分
